paragraphs.text: The Savaen Expanses were a large stretch of forest during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Although their exact location is unknown, the Savaen Expanses were part of the continent of Terisiare during the Dark Age . The forest was known to host elves and spiders , including Sidaine of Savaen . " Purity of magic can only come from the purity of the land. How can a meal nourish if the ingredients are spoiled? ", Sidaine is known to have said.

The Savaen Expanses were known to Mairsil at the Conclave of Mages , and he compared their much more impressive size to the smaller yet deadly Tanglewoods when he told Jodah about the lands around the school.
